description_en: Attaches a network instance to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用AttachCenChildInstance接口将网络实例加载到云企业网实例中
kebab_example: aliyun cbn attach-cen-child-instance --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmc0000 --child-instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnvx0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachCenChildInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance to attach
parameters.help_zh: 指定待加载的网络实例的ID
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络。

VBR：边界路由器。

CCN：云连接网
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region where the network instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所在的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the network instance belongs.

This parameter is required if you want to attach a cross-account network instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属的阿里云账号ID（主账号）。

如果您要加载跨账号的网络实例，本参数必填
parameters.name: child_instance_owner_id
